note: Sanitized public research metadata derived from the tracker. The tracker is the source of truth. Claim titles are reproduced with attribution (MIT / CC BY 4.0).

evidence.title: The reported demonstration device (iPhone 18 Pro) uses A20 Pro, so the demonstration is not direct evidence for A17 Pro
evidence.limitations: The chip mapping comes from Apple. The identity of the demonstration device comes from press reports.

evidence.title: iOS 27.0.1 build 24A446 is the build for iPhone16,2 (iPhone 15 Pro Max)
evidence.limitations: No Apple-hosted build record was located. The Apple pages checked do not list build numbers, so verification relies on third-party indexes.

evidence.title: iOS 27.0.1 has no published CVE entries in Apple's security releases index
evidence.limitations: The note reflects Apple's published CVE entries. It does not prove that no security fixes exist, and the index extract does not show the build number.

evidence.title: Dopamine 3.0 release notes state a Titan PPL/SPTM bypass for all devices on iOS 16.5.1 to 17.3.1
evidence.limitations: Release-note statement, verified as text. The bypass method is not described. The chip table is secondary.

evidence.title: iOS 27.0.1 (24A446) is unsigned in the ipsw.me index on 2026-11-12, after a 2026-11-02 report that it was signed
evidence.limitations: Signing status can change. The index is a third-party status field, not an Apple statement. Do not assume that a restore to this build is possible.

evidence.title: The device identifier iPhone16,2 corresponds to the iPhone 15 Pro Max
evidence.limitations: Single third-party index for the mapping. No Apple device-identifier page was checked.

evidence.title: The iPhone 15 Pro Max uses the Apple A17 Pro chip
evidence.limitations: Wikipedia is a secondary source. Apple's product page did not expose the chip name in this check, and the Pro Max chip is inferred from the Pro page plus the task profile.

evidence.title: No public complete exploit chain applicable to iPhone 15 Pro Max on iOS 27.0.1 has been verified
evidence.limitations: Based on absence in the searches and secondary reports. This is not a proof of absence.

evidence.title: No publicly installable jailbreak tool is verified for iOS 27.0.1 on A17 Pro
evidence.limitations: Based on the sources reviewed. Some websites host unverified downloads and must not be trusted.

evidence.title: The kernelcache and the SPTM and TXM monitor images of 24A446 carry the arm64e subtype bit in their Mach-O headers
evidence.limitations: A build-level header flag. It does not show that pointer authentication is enforced on any device.

evidence.title: The default-branch README of the Dopamine repository lists rootless ranges to iOS 17.3.1 (arm64e) and 18.7.1 (arm64), and no iOS 27 range
evidence.limitations: A repository statement at the recorded head. Rootful status is not stated. The A17 Pro is not named.
